title: The Core Council may grant to the Sky Frontier Foundation without a separate governance decision per grant
content:
A.2.3.1.2.2.2 allocates 10% of Step 1 Capital to the Core Council, "which directs these funds across governance operations and development work," covering active Core Executor Agents, "Core Executor Agents whose terms have ended in the last four (4) years," Aligned Delegates, the Core Governance Reward Primitive, and grants to the Sky Frontier Foundation. It then grants standing authority: "The Core Council is authorized to direct grants from this allocation to the Sky Frontier Foundation without a separate governance decision for each grant."

This is block funding rather than line-item appropriation. Governance fixes the envelope — 10% — and delegates composition, including the choice to "pay these recipients directly or to fund the Core Council Buffer... and Aligned Delegates Buffer for subsequent disbursement." The trade is straightforward: per-grant votes on governance operating costs would consume the very governance capacity being funded.

Two details are notable. Continuing to fund Core Executor Agents for four years after their terms end pays for something other than current work — plausibly deferred compensation or a non-compete-like retention of aligned expertise — and it is unusual enough to be worth flagging. And A.2.3.1.2.2.1 lets the sibling Fortification Foundation allocation "be directed to the Sky Frontier Foundation on an interim basis" until the Fortification Foundation is operational, so a body that does not yet function still has its 10% claim reserved and temporarily rerouted rather than lapsing.

The Atlas concedes the arrangement is unfinished: the split among components, "including the mechanism by which Core Executor Agents are elected to Core Executor Slots, will be specified in a future iteration."
description: Its 10% of Step 1 Capital covers Core Executor Agents past and present, Aligned Delegates and the governance reward, with buffer routing and grant approval left to Council discretion.
